component.name: Panel RK MG5
component.summary: Control panel for the Royal Kludge MG5 mouse

description.p: Open source control panel for the Royal Kludge MG5 mouse on Linux. Configure DPI levels and their colours, polling rate, lift-off distance, debounce, sensor mode, Motion Sync, Ripple Control, angle snapping, glass mode and sleep time, remap the six buttons and keep complete profiles that can be switched from the system tray.
Not affiliated with or endorsed by Royal Kludge.
